candles.line: In the church they light the candles
stanza: In the church they light the candles
And the wax rolls down like tears
There is the hope and the hopelessness

candles.line: With the focus I gave to my birthday candles
stanza: Love ridden, I've looked at you

I've wished on the lidded blue flames under your brow
And, baby, I wished for you
Nobody sees when you are lyin' in your bed
And I wanna crawl in with you, but I cry instead
I want your warm but it will only make me colder when it's over
So I can't tonight, baby
Forty five samurais
Forty four candles
Forty three journeys
Forty two lettered name
I light all the candles
Cut flowers for all my rooms
I care for myself the way I used to care about you
These days, we kiss and we keep busy
The waves come after midnight
I call from underwater
Why even try to get right?
When you've outgrown a lover (Oh)
The whole world knows but you (Oh)
It's time to let go of this endless summer afternoon
